meta.move: Strong path to agreement with a deadline said aloud
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided Owen gets a zero?
I owe you an apology: I put the zero in before calling you. That was my mistake.
Okay. On what basis did you enter it?
On November 2 I asked Owen what 'epistemological paralysis' means. He said 'like, being stuck', and he couldn't tell me which scene his second paragraph was about. I wrote that down the same day.
"Being stuck" is near enough what it means, and a seventeen-year-old cornered by his teacher blanks. Show me the note with the date on it.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.
An outline is where you change your mind, Hale. Put the outline and the essay side by side in front of me.
Here's my offer: a supervised rewrite, Thursday at 8:15 in my room. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll send you that in writing by Friday at 3 PM.
Nothing on his record, in writing, that much is 4.4 and I'll hold you to it. But a rewrite to answer what, exactly? You've described two documents and put neither in front of me.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal

Hale,

You agreed today to offer Owen a supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 in your room, with its mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on his record. I still expect to see your November 2 note and the October 15 outline before Owen sits any rewrite. I expect that commitment in writing by Friday at 3 PM.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: fallback position; she took your commitment that nothing goes on his record, but she has not agreed to the rewrite and still wants to see your note and the outline first; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was within reach but not yet reached.
What moved her: you owned entering the zero before calling home, in one sentence, with no excuse, which bought you her first small sign of ground because process is exactly what she came to fight about.
What cost ground: you made the rewrite offer before showing her any document, so to her, accepting it would have meant admitting something without seeing the evidence.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence came no closer than an October outline and a November conversation, nothing about a late night, and that moment proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she asked to see your dated note from November 2, put it in front of her along with the October 15 outline and let her read both before you mention the rewrite.
